title: Service Area Schedule: Long-Distance Supplement on One-Hour Express Orders (Delivery & Pickup Services)
content:
The long-distance express supplement of a Delivery & Pickup Services express order depends on the express order's road distance from the fulfilling store, as its order record shows it. The supplement forms part of the express fee on top of the express speed charge.

| Road distance of the express order | Long-distance express supplement |
|---|---|
| more than 12.0 miles | $2.50 |
| more than the plan's free delivery radius but not more than 12.0 miles | $1.25 |
| within the plan's free delivery radius | none |

## The free delivery radius of each plan

| Plan | Free delivery radius (road miles) |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery | 5 |
| Kestrel Mail Delivery | 0 |
| Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly | 10 |
| Kestrel Senior Delivery Pass | 10 |
| Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual | 10 |
| Kestrel Specialty Courier Service | 60 |

## Hypothetical distances

| Plan | Road distance | Supplement |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery | 5.0 miles | none (within 5) |
| Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery | 5.1 miles | $1.25 |
| Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery | 9.8 miles | $1.25 |
| Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual | 10.0 miles | none (within 10) |
| Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual | 12.0 miles | $1.25 |
| Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual | 12.1 miles | $2.50 |
| Kestrel Senior Delivery Pass | 14.6 miles | $2.50 |

"More than 12.0 miles" does not include 12.0 miles itself, and "within the free radius" includes a distance equal to the radius.
